fields.System.Title: EPIC TRF — Transfers
fields.System.Description:
Goal

Stock moves between warehouses, and is properly accounted for while it is on a lorry belonging
to neither site.

Business value

Multi-site networks rebalance stock constantly. Without a transfer flow, that movement happens
as an ad-hoc shipment out of one system and a blind receipt into another, and the difference
between the two is invisible until year end.

Scope

In. Transfer orders. Origin allocation, picking, packing, and dispatch. In-transit virtual
stock. Destination receipt validated against the dispatch. Partial receipt. Discrepancy
recording and investigation. Network stock visibility.

Out. Transport booking and route planning. Freight cost allocation. Customs and export
documentation.

Done when

  • A transfer can be created, allocated, picked, packed, and dispatched from the origin.
  • Dispatched stock sits in a virtual in-transit location, available at neither site.
  • The destination receipt is validated against what the origin dispatched.
  • A partial receipt leaves the balance in transit rather than losing it.
  • A quantity mismatch creates an investigation record with an owner, not an auto-adjustment.
  • Overdue in-transit stock is aged and escalated.

Key risks

| Risk | Why it matters | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Dispatched but never received | Stock sits in transit forever; network total overstated | [doc 09 §9.1](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Transfer received twice | Stock created from nothing | [doc 09 §9.2](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Discrepancy auto-adjusted | Hides theft, picking errors, and receiving errors equally well | [doc 09 §9.3](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Timezone and clock differences | Receipt appears to precede dispatch | [doc 09 §9.4](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| In-transit counted as available | Over-promising at both sites | [doc 05 WF 12](../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
